pages.text: The Aimless Colony inhabits the kingdom’s assembly chambers. Eyes and gold cores show between its uneven masses of gel. Its body and fragments share a bond, and its attacks leave the chamber intact.
pages.title: The chamber colony

pages.text: Watch the colony’s movements and the warnings around it. Its behavior may change during the fight; respond to the signals you see in the chamber.
pages.title: Read the signs

pages.text: For combat rewards, stay nearby for at least 30 seconds by default, contribute damage, healing, protection or a successful rally, and be alive nearby when the colony falls. Creative and Spectator modes do not count. Companions’ contributions count for their owner.
pages.title: Fight together

pages.text: Your first clear of each chamber grants a Colony Heart and a record. Later clears give two Cohesion Shards.
